root_cause: In the introducing tree, servercert skips verifystatus() when connssl->reused_session is true, but ossl_connect_step1 still loads a cached session under if(ssl_config->primary.sessionid). The 2025 fix gates a later cache_session API. The equivalent repair for the 2023 tree is the one-line intro-era guard if(ssl_config->primary.sessionid && !conn_config->verifystatus), forcing a full handshake and status check.
findings: The new reused_session condition suppresses verifystatus, while the existing cache lookup can still offer a session when status verification is requested.
